resources.string: Favorites, albums, people, hidden folders and settings, in a file encrypted with a password
From a .focale file, on this phone or a new one

Focale regularly saves an encrypted copy of your favorites, albums, people, hidden folders and settings to a folder of your choice. The last 3 backups are kept, and each one restores with its password, like a manual backup. The vault isn’t included: it has its own backup.

Choose a password to encrypt the backup of your favorites, albums, people, hidden folders and settings. You’ll need it to restore them, and it can’t be recovered. Photos and videos aren’t included: copy them to the new phone separately.
Enter the password chosen when the backup was created. Focale checks the whole backup before restoring anything.
Favorites, albums (matched by name) and hidden folders are added to those on this phone. Settings are replaced by those of the backup.
